description: Run Python code in a sandbox: execute Python in Google's hosted sandbox (not on this service's machines) and get the code, its printed output and the outcome back. Use it for calculations, data transforms and checks an agent should not do in its head. Input: code. Questions over BigQuery data: data.query. $0.25 per call. Returns: code, output, outcome, summary, model.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_code_execute
title: Execute Python
